name: The Laurus, Singapore
insider_take: The Laurus redefines tropical luxury on Singapore's playground island, where colonial heritage meets contemporary sophistication in an exclusive resort setting.
whats_special: This intimate Luxury Collection property occupies a prime position on Sentosa Island, featuring only 50 suites making it one of Singapore's most exclusive retreats. The hotel's design pays homage to Singapore's colonial past while incorporating modern Asian elements, and guests enjoy privileged access to nearby attractions including Universal Studios and the S.E.A. Aquarium.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing the South China Sea for stunning sunset views, and take advantage of the complimentary island shuttle to explore Sentosa's beaches and attractions without the mainland crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature spa treatments incorporating traditional Asian healing techniques, and evening cocktails at the rooftop bar overlooking the Singapore Strait. Also explore nearby Palawan Beach, consistently ranked among Asia's best family beaches, just minutes from your suite.
pros: Prime Sentosa Island location with resort atmosphere
Luxury Collection brand standards with personalized service
Close proximity to Universal Studios and beach attractions
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and amenities
cons: Island location requires transportation to downtown Singapore
